evidence.note: GFPO samples a larger group of rollouts per problem during RL training and updates only on the top-k by length or by reward-per-token, converting extra training-time compute into shorter responses at inference.
evidence.title: Sample More to Think Less: Group Filtered Policy Optimization for Concise Reasoning

evidence.note: FROST uses attention weights to identify and prune sentence-level 'reasoning outliers' from a reasoning model's chain of thought, reporting an average 69.68% token reduction and 26.70% accuracy gain over the base model on four maths benchmarks.
evidence.title: FROST: Filtering Reasoning Outliers with Attention for Efficient Reasoning
